action.objective: Verify the reserved candidate Nxd4 at full depth before committing.
action.rationale: Broad depth-2 search suggested f3d4 as the only exact-bound top candidate (score 16, PV Nxd4/Bb4) and it holds the reserved verification budget. The alternatives d1d2 and d1b1 are upper bounds (could be worse) and include an early-major penalty; f3d2 and a2a4 scored lower. Verifying Nxd4 at the true target depth with the full reserved allowance is the correct next step before any commit.
